    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL;

WHERE s."eye_colour_id" = s."hair_colour_id"

1456:
SELECT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    MAX(e."cost") AS max_cost
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
GROUP BY m."member_id", m."first_name", m."last_name"

LIMIT 5;
1453:
SELECT e."event_name"
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN expense ex ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e."event_id", e."event_name"
HAVING SUM(ex."cost") < (
    SELECT SUM(ex2."cost") / COUNT(DISTINCT e2."event_id")
    FROM budget b2
    JOIN expense ex2 ON ex2."link_to_budget" = b2."budget_id"
    JOIN event e2 ON e2."event_id" = b2."link_to_event"
    WHERE b2."category" = 'Parking'
)

1428:

1340:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") = 2019 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END)
    -
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") = 2020 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END)
    AS "difference"
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") IN (2019, 2020);

1339:

JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"

1359:
WITH sums AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" LIKE '%Yearly Kickoff%' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END) AS yearly_kickoff_sum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" LIKE '%October Meeting%' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END) AS october_meeting_sum
    FROM "budget" b
    JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
    WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
)

SELECT
    yearly_kickoff_sum::NUMERIC / NULLIF(october_meeting_sum, 0) AS ratio
FROM sums;

    m.last_name,
